source: &eIron's Arms 'n Artifice&r arms you with black-powder firearms, from a crude &aFlintlock&r up to a &6Clockwork Rifle&r, and lets you rebuild each one with modifiers that change how it shoots.
&eJust Hammers&r mines a 3x3 area with every swing. The larger hammers reach further, up to the 5x5x5 Destructor.
&aHearts&r are a key component of &eBaubley Heart Canisters&r.
&eMore Red&r is redstone taken seriously. Proper wiring, logic gates and mechanical power, all in flat panels rather than a room full of repeaters.
Red Alloy here is the &aRedstone Alloy Ingot&r. More Red's hand recipe for it is turned off in this pack, so make it in an alloy machine such as the Energized Power &aAlloy Furnace&r.
